research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: H3X Technologies is engaged in developing advanced electric propulsion systems, focusing on innovations such as a motor assembly with an axial circuit assembly and switch mount, a thermal cap for stator winding, a distributed DC link for integrated motor drives, specialized electrical windings, and electric motors with integrated inverters and shared cooling systems. These efforts target improvements in motor efficiency, thermal management, and system integration for high-performance applications.

about_short_description.short_description: H3X manufactures advanced electric propulsion systems for commercial aviation and other high performance applicaitons.

product.name: HPDM-350
product.description: A 350 kW integrated motor drive designed for aerospace and defense applications, providing high torque and fault tolerance for electric propulsion.

product.name: HPDM-1500
product.description: A 1.5 MW multisector integrated motor drive for electric aircraft and ships, offering high torque and fault-tolerant operation.

product.name: HPDM-2300
product.description: A 2.3 MW multisector integrated motor drive for high-power electric propulsion in aerospace and heavy industry applications.

product.name: HPDM-140
product.description: A 140 kW integrated motor drive with high power density and efficiency, usable as motor or generator for aerospace, defense, marine, and industrial applications.

product.name: HPDM-90S
product.description: A 92 kW submerged marine propulsion motor with integrated inverter and direct cooling, designed for compact, quiet operation in marine vessels.

product.name: HPDM-30
product.description: A 33 kW integrated motor drive with high power density and efficiency for aerospace, defense, marine, and industrial uses.
